function.name: verify_connection
function.description: Confirm the SKU.io connection and identify the tenant (via tenant_id) so SOPs can be grounded in the customer's real setup (their warehouses, custom fields, pricing tiers). Requires no scopes. Do not use /api/auth/profile: it is session-only and returns 403 "This endpoint is not available to API tokens." for every PAT. OPTIONAL — reading the public documentation and changelog (docs.sku.io) needs no token; only account-specific grounding does. (GET /api/me)
